question: In what setting may placement occur, what is it named, and to whom is this stated?
premises: The setting is on a seat.
That placement is named installation, addressed to the clan-leader goddess.
inference: On the seat, placement may occur; it is installation, O clan-leader goddess.
uncertainties: Object being placed not specified by this verse alone
plain_english: On the seat, placement may occur; it is installation, O clan-leader goddess.
